You mentioned “
Could you please confirm the exact time stamp of the issue occurred for further analysis?
” – I already wrote the exact time in the ticket, and it occurred/was active when I turned the ticket in.
The customer is raging and angry at us, so please resolve these issues ASAP

Lara

additional_info.subject: RE: AW: AW: ID0435966-DC/Si-D/AT-[Y2/RN300000003010]  Second outlet on the charger is faulted CRM:02682000183
additional_info.body:
Dear Lara,
I hope this email finds you well. I wanted to provide you with a detailed update regarding your inquiry about outlet 4 of the charger.
I'm pleased to confirm that outlet 4 is functioning perfectly. Our latest system check shows that the outlet's status is "Available," as confirmed by the backend status report. I've personally verified this through the
frontend interface, which shows all outlets are currently available for use.
Last status sent to backend from outlet 4:
2025-07-08T16:34:44.023662+00:00 [FW060103G1] sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/5bb34ddd57a0[637]: OCPP: Send command: StatusNotification (8c75a1b3-a358-4d23-a828-03b77432eded) - {"connectorId":4,"errorCode":"NoError","status":"Available"}
Charger Interface:
While reviewing your case, I should mention that we are aware of an occasional status reporting discrepancy between Sifinity systems and the real outlet status. Our technical team is actively working on resolving this minor
reporting issue. However, I want to assure you that this does not affect the actual functionality or availability of the chargers for customer use.
Please don't hesitate to reach out if you need any clarification or have additional questions.
With best regards,
Joao Francisco Louro Cardoso
Siemens S.A.

additional_info.body:
Hello Daniel,
This ticket has been open because there was coap issues that lead to outlets OoO. After installing the Ecog Hotfix this is fixed.
However customer reported that the HMI was OFF, I didn't understood correctly if is the full HMI or just the RFID lights.
I see many charging sessions so I don't think there is any issue there, or at least a major one that block the customer to use the charger.
I will proceed to close this ticket. If you think it's necessary to inspect the charger please proceed to it and attach later the report here, otherwise check the HMI and RFID lights on the next preventive maintenance intervention.
